# Compiler Unicode diagnostics

`compiler_unicode.json` contains the 16 fullwidth, ideographic and zero-width
diagnostic snapshots from Gleam v1.19.2. Sources and rendered reports come
from `compiler-core/src/parse/snapshots/gleam_core__parse__tests__unicode_*.snap`.
The `report` feature compares every report byte for byte.

Source: https://github.com/gleam-lang/gleam/tree/v1.19.2/compiler-core/src/parse/snapshots
